ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the filed EPS row 0.38 carries the opposite sign to the net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file (-0.142815). A share-count basis difference moves a filed per-share figure by tens of percent, not by a factor, and the inputs on file do not settle which side is wrong. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: earnings are reported in CAD but the security is listed and priced in ZAR; a multiple across two currencies is not a ratio. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so all are withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
